name: Greedy Quad Vertex Generation with AO and Anisotropy
definition: Converts a GreedyQuad (x, y, w, h) into four vertex indices packed into u32, applying ambient occlusion (AO) blending and anisotropy flip logic.
summary: Greedy Quad Vertex Generation with AO and Anisotropy is a method that corrects interpolation anisotropy by rotating vertex order to connect high-occlusion corners, smoothing shading gradients across greedy mesh quads.
